t: Mains powered base with rechargeable lithium cell back up and built in RadioLINK. Interlinks the Aico 140RC Series Alarms through wireless interconnection, so when one alarm is triggered, all alarms in the system sound. Once all the alarms have been installed the RadioLINK system is secured by a special House Coding function to safeguard the system from interference from other RF systems. Allows for easy expansion of an existing hardwired interconnected system.
b: 5 Year Manufacturer’s Guarantee (Registration Required, T&Cs Apply)
